title: XClearlag
description: A lightweight and efficient ClearLag plugin for Paper 1.21.x. Automatically removes dropped items, sends configurable warnings, and helps keep your server running smoothly.
body:
# XClearlag

A lightweight, fast, and configurable ClearLag plugin for Paper servers.

## Features

* Automatic dropped-item cleanup
* Configurable cleanup interval
* Configurable warning messages
* Manual `/clearlag` command
* Lightweight and optimized
* Java 21 support
* Paper 1.21.x support

## Commands

| Command     | Description                     |
| ----------- | ------------------------------- |
| `/clearlag` | Removes dropped items instantly |

## Permissions

| Permission      | Description                 | Default |
| --------------- | --------------------------- | ------- |
| `xclearlag.use` | Allows usage of `/clearlag` | OP      |

## Configuration

```yaml
clear-interval-seconds: 600

warnings:
  - 60
  - 30
  - 10
  - 5
```

## How It Works

XClearlag automatically removes dropped item entities at a configurable interval to reduce entity lag and improve server performance. Before a cleanup occurs, players receive warning messages so they have time to pick up valuable items.

## Compatibility

* Paper 1.21.x
* Java 21

## Support

If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please open an issue on the project's repository.
